title: Singapore Wins World's Best Airline Award for 2026
paragraphs: It's been a hard year for air travel. Airplane fuel prices are up to 70% more expensive this year, so ticket costs are increasing too.

But if you have to pay more, you may as well fly with the best! And according to this year's Skytrax World Airline Awards, that's Singapore Airlines, which has been named the World's Best Airline for 2026.

Air travel rating company Skytrax chooses its award winners through an online customer survey offered in English, French, Portuguese, Spanish, Turkish, Chinese, Japanese and Korean. This year's survey ran from September 2025 to August 2026, and customers from more than 100 countries took part.
Singapore Airlines was also named the World's Best Economy Class Airline, making it a strong choice for those who don't want to pay extra for business or first class.

Goh Choon Phong from Singapore Airlines said about the wins, "We are grateful to our customers for their trust and support, and we are committed to delivering an exceptional, world-class travel experience every time they fly with us."

Qatar Airways — last year's winner — was named the world's second best airline. Its bosses won't be too unhappy with the fall to second place though, since it was also named the World's Best Business Class Airline and the Best Airline in the Middle East.
It also won World's Best Business Class Lounge for its Al Mourjan Business Lounge — The Garden, which is at Hamad Airport in Qatar. And it won the first Skytrax award for World's Best Onboard Wi-Fi.

Cathay Pacific Airways was named the third best airline in the world, and also won World's Best Cabin Crew and World's Best First Class Airline Lounge for The Wing Lounge at Hong Kong International Airport.
